Minister Rijiju, Sanjay Raut Clash Over Ram Temple Remarks

Union Minister Kiren Rijiju accused the Congress, Samajwadi Party (SP), and Left parties of being "anti-Ram." Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Sanjay Raut responded, stating that his party raised its voice against an "alleged theft" and not against Lord Ram. The exchange occurred following statements made by Rijiju.
